0-000.text: The sun rises over Sønderborg, and a bird sings in a big tree.

0-001.text: The house is white, and the door is red.

0-002.text: There is a small kitchen with a table, a chair and an old lamp.

0-003.text: Mum is making food, while dad drinks coffee by the window.

0-004.text: The child eats an apple and drinks milk.

0-005.text: On the table there is cheese, butter, salt and an egg.

0-006.text: The dog runs out of the door, while a cat still sleeps on a bed.

0-007.text: Their room is small, but the window is big.

0-008.text: The girl has a flower in her hand, and the boy has lost a tooth.

0-009.text: She has long hair, a small nose and a happy mouth.

0-010.text: He closes one eye and puts a hat on his head.

0-011.text: The cat sits by his leg, while his foot hurts.

0-012.text: The boy has a ball under his arm, and the father drinks a beer.

0-013.text: The girl points with a finger at a black plane in a clear sky.

0-014.text: Her heart beats, because the family is travelling today.

0-015.text: They walk down a street in the middle of an old town.

0-016.text: A young woman and an old man wait by a church.

0-017.text: In a shop they buy meat, fish and vegetables.

0-018.text: They also take a potato, sugar and a big cake.

0-019.text: Dad fetches money at a bank, because he wants to buy a book.

0-020.text: Mum works at a hospital, but today she is off.

0-021.text: Her brother is a teacher at a school.

0-022.text: His sister drives a red car, and her son has a bicycle.

0-023.text: A horse stands in a park by the water.

0-024.text: Their daughter and a friend read a book if it rains.

0-025.text: One evening last week snow fell over the whole town.

0-026.text: Now a train is waiting, and a bus drives past.

0-027.text: From the window they see the beach and a big sea.

0-028.text: Night falls, and you can see the moon and a bright star.

0-029.text: They love to travel, even though the journey is long.

0-030.text: Casey is happy, because the suitcase is full of words.
